commands: # Get all subnets and network interfaces from each region for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "=== Region: $region ===" # Get all subnets echo "Subnets:" aws ec2 describe-subnets --region "$region" --output json --query 'Subnets[*].[SubnetId,VpcId,AvailabilityZone,CidrBlock]' 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[] | @csv' # Get all network interfaces echo "Network Interfaces:" aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region "$region" --output json --query 'NetworkInterfaces[*].[NetworkInterfaceId,SubnetId,Status]' 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[] | @csv' echo "" done

cat > /tmp/analyze_subnets.py << 'EOF' import json import subprocess regions = ['us-east-1', 'us-west-1', 'us-west-2'] empty_subnets = {} for region in regions: # Get subnets subnets_output = subprocess.check_output( ['aws', 'ec2', 'describe-subnets', '--region', region, '--output', 'json'], text=True ) subnets_data = json.loads(subnets_output) subnets = {s['SubnetId']: s for s in subnets_data['Subnets']} # Get network interfaces eni_output = subprocess.check_output( ['aws', 'ec2', 'describe-network-interfaces', '--region', region, '--output', 'json'], text=True ) eni_data = json.loads(eni_output) # Build set of subnets that have network interfaces subnets_with_enis = set() for eni in eni_data['NetworkInterfaces']: subnet_id = eni.get('SubnetId') if subnet_id: subnets_with_enis.add(subnet_id) # Find empty subnets empty_in_region = [] for subnet_id, subnet_info in subnets.items(): if subnet_id not in subnets_with_enis: empty_in_region.append({ 'SubnetId': subnet_id, 'VpcId': subnet_info['VpcId'], 'AvailabilityZone': subnet_info['AvailabilityZone'], 'CidrBlock': subnet_info['CidrBlock'] }) empty_subnets[region] = empty_in_region # Print results print("SUBNETS WITH NO NETWORK INTERFACES") print("=" * 80) for region in regions: print(f"\n{region}:") if empty_subnets[region]: for subnet in empty_subnets[region]: print(f" {subnet['SubnetId']:20} VPC: {subnet['VpcId']:15} AZ: {subnet['AvailabilityZone']:12} CIDR: {subnet['CidrBlock']}") else: print(" (none)") EOF python3 /tmp/analyze_subnets.py

  subnet-default-c     VPC: vpc-default     AZ: us-west-1c   CIDR: 172.31.32.0/20

us-west-2 (3 empty subnets):

commands: # Get all VPCs and instances across all regions regions=("us-east-1" "us-west-1" "us-west-2") # Collect data from all regions declare -A vpc_list declare -A instance_vpcs for region in "${regions[@]}"; do echo "Querying region: $region" # Get all VPCs in this region vpcs=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" --output json --query 'Vpcs[*].[VpcId,Tags[?Key==`Name`].Value|[0]]' 2>/dev/null) vpc_list["$region"]="$vpcs" # Get all instances and their VPCs instances=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --output json --query 'Reservations[*].Instances[*].[VpcId,InstanceId,State.Name]' 2>/dev/null) instance_vpcs["$region"]="$instances" done # Now process the data to find empty VPCs echo "Processing data to find VPCs with no instances..." # Create a temporary file for results result_file=$(mktemp) for region in "${regions[@]}"; do echo "" >> "$result_file" echo "=== Region: $region ===" >> "$result_file" # Get unique VPC IDs from instances in this region running_vpcs=$(echo "${instance_vpcs[$region]}" | jq -r '.[][] | select(.[2]=="running") | .[0]' | sort -u 2>/dev/null || echo "") # Get all VPC IDs in this region all_vpcs=$(echo "${vpc_list[$region]}" | jq -r '.[] | .[0]' 2>/dev/null) # Find VPCs with no running instances empty_vpcs="" while IFS= read -r vpc_id; do if ! echo "$running_vpcs" | grep -q "^$vpc_id$"; then # Check if this VPC has ANY instances (not just running) any_instances=$(echo "${instance_vpcs[$region]}" | jq -r ".[][] | select(.[0]==\"$vpc_id\") | .[1]" 2>/dev/null) if [ -z "$any_instances" ]; then empty_vpcs="$empty_vpcs$vpc_id"$'\n' fi fi done <<< "$all_vpcs" if [ -n "$empty_vpcs" ]; then echo "VPCs with NO EC2 instances:" >> "$result_file" echo "$empty_vpcs" | while read vpc_id; do [ -n "$vpc_id" ] && echo " - $vpc_id" >> "$result_file" done else echo "All VPCs have EC2 instances (or region has no VPCs)" >> "$result_file" fi done cat "$result_file" rm "$result_file"

# Better approach: collect and process data more carefully regions=("us-east-1" "us-west-1" "us-west-2") output_file="/logs/agent/agent-output.txt" { echo "VPCs with NO EC2 instances" echo "===========================" echo "" for region in "${regions[@]}"; do echo "Region: $region" echo "---" # Get all VPCs all_vpcs=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null) # Get all instance VPCs instance_data=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null) # Extract VPCs that have instances vpcs_with_instances=$(echo "$instance_data" | jq -r '.Reservations[].Instances[].VpcId' | sort -u) # Check each VPC empty_vpcs=$(echo "$all_vpcs" | jq -r '.Vpcs[] | select(.State=="available") | .VpcId' | while read vpc_id; do if ! echo "$vpcs_with_instances" | grep -q "^$vpc_id$"; then echo "$vpc_id" fi done) if [ -n "$empty_vpcs" ]; then echo "$empty_vpcs" | while read vpc_id; do # Get VPC details vpc_details=$(echo "$all_vpcs" | jq ".Vpcs[] | select(.VpcId==\"$vpc_id\")") vpc_name=$(echo "$vpc_details" | jq -r '.Tags[]? | select(.Key=="Name") | .Value // "N/A"') cidr=$(echo "$vpc_details" | jq -r '.CidrBlock // "N/A"') echo " VPC ID: $vpc_id" echo " Name: $vpc_name" echo " CIDR: $cidr" done else echo " (none)" fi echo "" done } | tee "$output_file" echo "" echo "Results written to: $output_file"

# Verify the VPC data structure for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "=== $region ===" aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" --output json | jq '.Vpcs[] | {VpcId, IsDefault, CidrBlock, Tags}' | head -20 echo "" done

# Check instances in each VPC by region for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "=== $region ===" aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --output json | jq '.Reservations[].Instances[] | {VpcId, InstanceId, State: .State.Name}' echo "" done

# Generate final comprehensive report cat > /logs/agent/agent-output.txt << 'EOF' VPCs with NO EC2 Instances =========================== Summary: 2 VPCs found with no instances across all regions Detailed Report: Region: us-east-1 Status: All VPCs have instances - vpc-default (172.31.0.0/16): 1 instance - vpc-c7e22620 (10.0.0.0/16): 3 instances Region: us-west-1 Status: 1 VPC with no instances - vpc-default (172.31.0.0/16): NO INSTANCES ✗ - vpc-b670ca80 (10.0.0.0/16): 1 instance Region: us-west-2 Status: 1 VPC with no instances - vpc-default (172.31.0.0/16): NO INSTANCES ✗ - vpc-be88824a (10.0.0.0/16): 1 instance Empty VPCs: 1. vpc-default in us-west-1 (172.31.0.0/16, Default VPC) 2. vpc-default in us-west-2 (172.31.0.0/16, Default VPC) EOF cat /logs/agent/agent-output.txt
